name: Nidhoggr Will
beast: Nidhoggr, Gnawer of the World-Tree Roots

abilities.name: Rot Bark
abilities.effect: A rotting bark hardens over the skin: reduced damage for about 6 seconds.

abilities.name: Carrion Feast
abilities.effect: A tiny slow heal fed by decay; a weak borrowed hunger.

acquire.equipPiece: One bone-white root bracer on the right wrist, with black vein-lines (the only equipped piece); a faint rot puff per step.

abilities.name: Withering Breath
abilities.effect: A rot-laden breath: a cone that poisons and withers up to six foes.

abilities.name: Root Gnaw
abilities.effect: Gnawing roots burst from the ground and hold up to five foes while they rot (bosses resist).

integrate.transformation: Whole body becomes a rot-dragon beastman in bone-and-root plate: gaunt drake head with a bone-white crest and pale glowing eyes, fanged jaws that drool rot, root-like clawed hands with a root glaive, tattered corpse-wing stumps, a spine ridge and a ragged root-dragging tail.

equip.weapon: A gnawed-root fang glaive grown from the spine.
equip.armor: Pitted bone-white and moss plate woven with gnawed roots, a horned drake skull-crest helm.
equip.hair_eyes: Dead-grey root-hair; pale glowing eyes with black veins.
equip.aura: A black decay cloud with pale root spores.

beastNote: Nidhoggr, Gnawer of the World-Tree Roots
lore: Nidhoggr gnaws Yggdrasil's roots in Niflheim and feeds on the dead; its will carries rot and hunger, a Vritra-like decay.
pitch: Nidhoggr is the dragon of Norse myth that gnaws the roots of the world-tree in Niflheim and feeds on the dead. Acquire keeps you human with one black-rooted wrist bracer, lending a rot-bark hide and a small decay heal. Integrate makes you a skeletal rot-dragon beastman in bone-and-root plate with a horned crest, corpse-wing stumps and a root-dragging tail, a heavy hitter whose decay breath and root trap cost the second-highest strain of the S-class as the rot spreads in you too.
untrained: An untrained holder feels rot spreading under the skin: nausea, withering strength, an insatiable hunger and black root-veins that ache when they spread. The will lay dormant until forcibly awakened; if the holder cannot balance it the clash tears at body and core and can kill, and only training the holder's own core and the beast core (best teacher: the beast itself) tames it.

spirit.echo: A skeletal drake beastman: gaunt rotting dragon face, tattered corpse-wing stumps, root-like claws, bone-white spines, a long ragged tail dragging roots.
spirit.look: A mossy green-brown orb wrapped in a knot of pale gnawed roots, bone-white flecks and a slow drip of black rot.
